name: Bizzswatches – Variation Swatches for WooCommerce
author: Saiful Islam

sections.description:
Bizzswatches is a powerful WooCommerce plugin that transforms the default dropdown select boxes for product variations into beautiful, user-friendly swatches. Display your product attributes as colors, images, buttons, or radio buttons.

Key Features

Color Swatches
Display color options as beautiful color circles or squares. Perfect for clothing, accessories, and any product with color variations.

Image Swatches
Use custom images to represent product variations. Great for patterns, textures, or any visual variation.

Button Swatches
Convert dropdown menus to stylish button labels. Ideal for sizes, materials, or any text-based variation.

Multiple Shape Styles
Choose from rounded, squared, or circle shapes to match your store’s design.

Tooltip Support
Show helpful tooltips on swatch hover to provide more information about each variation.

Stock Behavior Options
Configure how out-of-stock variations are displayed – blur, cross out, or hide completely.

Product-Level Settings
Override global settings on individual products for complete customization control.

Why Choose Bizzswatches?

  • Easy Setup – Works out of the box with no coding required
  • WooCommerce Native – Built specifically for WooCommerce
  • Lightweight – Minimal impact on page load speed
  • Customizable – Extensive settings to match your design
  • Modern Code – Built with OOP patterns and WordPress standards
  • HPOS Compatible – Works with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Future-Ready – Designed for easy premium extension

Quick Start Guide

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Products > Attributes
  3. Create or edit an attribute
  4. Select a swatch type (Color, Image, Button, or Radio)
  5. Configure attribute terms with colors or images
  6. Create variable products using your attributes
  7. That’s it! Swatches will automatically appear on product pages

Settings

Visit Bizz Swatchs > Settings to configure:

  • Enable/disable swatches
  • Select swatch shape style
  • Enable tooltip display
  • Configure out-of-stock behavior
  • Set swatch dimensions
  • Auto-convert dropdowns to buttons
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bizzswatches directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Bizz Swatchs to configure the plugin.
  4. Follow the Quick Start Guide to set up your attributes and products with swatches.
  5. Create or edit product attributes to set swatch types and values.
  6. Create variable products using those attributes to see the swatches in action.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with my theme?

Bizzswatches is designed to work with most WooCommerce-compatible themes. If you experience any issues, please contact support.

Can I use different swatch types for different attributes?

Yes! Each attribute can have its own swatch type. For example, use Color swatches for color attribute and Button swatches for size attribute.

Will this slow down my website?

No. Bizzswatches is built with performance in mind and adds minimal overhead to your pages.

How do I add colors or images to my swatches?

After creating a Color or Image type attribute, edit each term to add the color value or upload an image.

Can I override settings for specific products?

Yes! Each variable product has a “Swatches Settings” tab where you can override global settings.
